offlinePatch.crossReference: The launch fix itself is Steam's own Offline Mode switch, measured on Season 1 in docs/rea/19-offline-launch-stall.md (condition D: usable frontend at 11.63 s with the client and game cut off, against no launch in 220 s without it). It is a client-wide setting, not a per-game one.
